title: Plaque Psoriasis
guideline: AAD-NPF Guidelines of Care for the Management and Treatment of Psoriasis (2024)

clinical_targets.goal: ≥ 75% reduction in Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI-75) or PASI score ≤ 3
Total affected body surface area cleared to < 1% ('treat-to-target' strategy)
Screen for and arrest progression of Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA) dactylitis and enthesitis

steps.title: Mild-to-Moderate Plaque Psoriasis (< 10% BSA)
steps.rationale: Topical therapy is first-line. Fixed combination of a high-potency corticosteroid plus a vitamin D3 analogue provides synergistic anti-hyperkeratotic efficacy while reducing corticosteroid-induced atrophy.

drug_classes.role: Gold standard topical regimen to normalize keratinocyte proliferation and inhibit T-cell activation.
drug_classes.dosing: Calcipotriol 50 mcg/g + Betamethasone 0.5 mg/g foam/ointment (e.g. Enstilar) applied once daily for 4 weeks.
drug_classes.pearls: Combination provides faster clearance and greater safety profile than either agent alone. Do not exceed 100 g/week of Calcipotriol to avoid hypercalcemia risk.

steps.title: Moderate-to-Severe Plaque Psoriasis (> 10% BSA or High Impact Areas)
steps.rationale: When disease involves > 10% BSA, palms/soles, scalp, or genital areas, topical agents are insufficient. Escalate to oral non-biologic systemic agents (antimetabolites, oral retinoids, or PDE4 inhibitors).

drug_classes.role: Systemic immunomodulation and inhibition of epidermal hyperproliferation.
drug_classes.dosing: Methotrexate 10–25 mg orally once weekly; Acitretin 25–50 mg daily; Apremilast 30 mg twice daily (after 5-day titration).
drug_classes.pearls: Acitretin does not cause immunosuppression, making it ideal in patients with latent infections or malignancy history. Apremilast requires no routine lab monitoring but can cause transient diarrhea and nausea.

special_populations.pregnancy_lactation: Methotrexate and Acitretin are absolutely contraindicated (severe teratogenicity). Acitretin requires strict pregnancy prevention during therapy and for 3 FULL YEARS after discontinuation due to storage in adipose tissue. Topical low-to-medium steroids and narrow-band UVB phototherapy are safe.
special_populations.hepatic_impairment: Methotrexate and Acitretin are contraindicated in severe hepatic dysfunction. Avoid alcohol consumption with both.

monitoring: Methotrexate: baseline and periodic CBC, LFTs, creatinine, hepatitis B/C and TB screening. Acitretin: baseline and periodic fasting lipid panel (triglycerides) and LFTs.
